name: Fantasy Football
description: Commands for viewing league standings, scores, and statistics

commands.name: activity
commands.longDescription: View the most recent transactions in your fantasy football league, including trades, waiver claims, and roster moves.

examples.output: Lists recent trades, waiver claims, and roster moves

commands.name: standings
commands.description: Returns standings by week and year
commands.longDescription: View the league standings for a specific week and year, showing each team's record and position.

options.name: week
options.description: The week number to view standings for

examples.output: Shows the standings after week 14 of the 2024 season

commands.name: median
commands.description: Get ranked scores for a specific week and year
commands.longDescription: View all team scores for a specific week, ranked from highest to lowest. Useful for determining where your score falls relative to the league median.

examples.output: Shows all scores for week 10, ranked highest to lowest

tips: Use this to see if you would have beaten the league median
Great for comparing your score across the entire league

commands.name: closestscores
commands.description: Get the closest scores for a specific week and year
commands.longDescription: View the closest matchups for a given week, showing games decided by the smallest margins.

examples.output: Shows matchups with margins under 16 points

commands.name: trophies
commands.description: Returns trophies by week and year
commands.longDescription: View weekly awards including highest scorer, lowest scorer, closest game, and biggest blowout.

examples.output: Shows weekly awards: high score, low score, closest game, blowout

commands.name: ewins
commands.description: Returns expected wins vs actual wins
commands.longDescription: Analyze the luck factor in your season by comparing expected wins (based on all-play record) to actual wins. Shows who got lucky and who got unlucky.

options.name: week
options.description: The week number (cumulative through this week)

tips: Positive difference means you got lucky with your schedule
Negative difference means you were unlucky

commands.name: optimal
commands.longDescription: Compare your actual points scored to what you could have scored with optimal lineup decisions. Shows coaching efficiency.

options.name: week
options.description: The week number (cumulative through this week)

tips: Higher efficiency means better start/sit decisions
Week 18 shows the full season aggregate
